research.text: My research lies at the intersection of statistics and machine learning. My current work focuses on distributional learning , which leverages generative models to estimate complex probability distributions. I develop methods for statistical problems that involve distribution estimation, including causal inference , extrapolation , robustness to distributional shifts , dimension reduction , diffusion models , missing data , and simulation-based inference . I am also interested in the theoretical foundations of these methods and their applications to scientific domains, such as the emulation of physical climate models .
